headline: European Industry and Recyclers Clash Over Proposed Scrap Metal Export Curbs
summary: European manufacturers and metal recycling firms are divided over proposed restrictions on EU scrap metal exports, while major purchasing nations like India push to maintain access.
why: Scrap metal is a crucial secondary raw material for low-carbon steelmaking; trade restrictions affect European industrial input costs and global recycling trade flows.

impacts.name: European Metals & Mining
impacts.why: Proposed export restrictions affect feedstock availability and pricing for European manufacturers.
